gaps.sentence: Your luggage ___ (weigh) at check-in, so allow extra time.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + weighed. The agent (staff) is obvious.

gaps.sentence: The suspect ___ to have left the country.
We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The results ___ (EXPECT) to be announced later today.
gaps.explanation: 'Later today' requires the present: are expected to be announced.

gaps.sentence: The stolen car ___ (find) abandoned in a car park this morning.
gaps.explanation: 'This morning' (now over) takes past simple passive: was + found.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: She hates ___ (interrupt) when she's deep in work.
gaps.explanation: Passive gerund: being + past participle, after verbs like hate, like, avoid.

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + opened, with the agent in a by-phrase.
